claim: The Jev decision layer is wired end to end: core client, CLI, MCP server, policies and a skill.
evidence: jev/src/client.mjs implements decide() with retry, timeout and receipt writing
jev/src/cli.mjs exposes decide, check and policies
jev/src/mcp.mjs exposes jev_decide, jev_check and jev_policies over stdio
jev/skills/jev-decisions/SKILL.md documents when to route a decision to Jev
